title: Top level anyOf oneOf allOf in MCP tool input schema breaks headless claude
summary: Any MCP tool whose inputSchema has anyOf, oneOf, or allOf at the TOP level makes every headless `claude -p` invocation in this workspace fail with HTTP 400 "tools.N.custom.input_schema: input_schema does not support oneOf, allOf, or anyOf at the top level" — the whole tool list is rejected before the agent can act, so it is not isolated to the offending tool. Observed live: the ARC-AGI-3 Mode 0 bench (runner.py --agent-command "claude -p") returned that 400 for both A/B arms. Root cause was the top-level anyOf on subconscious_search_context and ask_subconscious in lib/mcp-core.js. Fix pattern: keep the schema flat (the API allows anyOf only when NESTED, not at the top level) and re-enforce any "at least one of X/Y/Z" cross-field requirement at runtime inside the tool's run handler by throwing an Error (mcp-core caught errors become isError tool results at lib/mcp-core.js:607). When adding any new MCP tool, never put anyOf/oneOf/allOf at the top level of inputSchema.
